_about: Screenshot ledger (scripts/screenshot_ledger.py, npm run ledger): one row per screenshot by SHA-256, with what it showed, the applied bundles that used it and where copies live (inbox = ~/Downloads/Retrobowl Uploads, archive = data/uploads/<bundle>/images, both outside git). Generated; never hand-edit.
